registers.name: tcop_version
registers.description: Tensor coprocessor version register. Reports the IP major and minor version numbers.

fields.name: major
fields.description:
Major version number of the tensor coprocessor. Software reads it to select compatible driver behavior.

Usage: Read after reset; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x1 major version 1 (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: 16-bit unsigned value.

fields.name: minor
fields.description:
Minor version number of the tensor coprocessor. Software reads it to identify compatible additions.

Usage: Read after reset; software never writes this field.

Values:
0x0 minor version 0 (reset value).

Unit: none.

Limits: 16-bit unsigned value.

registers.name: tcop_ctrl
registers.description: Tensor coprocessor control register. Enables the datapath and selects the operation mode.

fields.name: en
fields.description:
Tensor coprocessor enable. Enables the systolic-array datapath and instruction acceptance.

Usage: Written by software before issuing tensor instructions; may be changed only while the IP is idle (busy is 0).

Values:
0x0 disabled (reset value);
0x1 enabled.

Unit: none.

Limits: one-bit value.

fields.name: op_mode
soft_rst
fields.description:
Software reset. Resets the datapath to idle without deasserting the external reset.

Usage: Write 0x1 then 0x0 to issue a self-clearing reset; the IP returns to idle.

Values:
0x0 normal operation (reset value);
0x1 assert software reset.

Unit: none.

Limits: one-bit value.

registers.name: tcop_sts
registers.description: Tensor coprocessor status register. Reports busy, done and error state.

fields.name: busy
fields.description:
Busy status. Indicates the datapath is processing an offloaded instruction.

Usage: Software polls this field before reconfiguring; read-only.

Values:
0x0 idle (reset value);
0x1 busy.

Unit: none.

Limits: one-bit value.

fields.name: done
fields.description:
Done status. Indicates the last offloaded instruction completed and returned a result.

Usage: Hardware sets this field on completion; software writes 0x0 to clear it after observing.

Values:
0x0 not done (reset value);
0x1 done.

Unit: none.

Limits: one-bit value.

fields.name: err
fields.description:
Error status. Indicates the last offloaded instruction terminated with an error.

Usage: Hardware sets this field on error; software writes 0x1 to clear it.

Values:
0x0 no error (reset value);
0x1 error.

Unit: none.

Limits: one-bit value.

registers.name: tcop_cfg
registers.description: Tensor coprocessor configuration register. Holds the matrix dimension or stride for the next operation.

fields.name: cfg_val
fields.description:
Configuration value. Holds the matrix dimension or stride for the next offloaded operation.

Usage: Written by software before issuing the instruction; used by the datapath for operand addressing.

Values:
0x00000000 default (reset value);
0x00000001 to 0xFFFFFFFF configurable value.

Unit: none.

Limits: 32-bit value.
